account:
It is day 1, about 09:31. I have read today's appointment book and spent the morning in my office. My next appointment is the mill's grain inspection at ten; later I have lunch at home, council letters, tea with my neighbour, office hours, and an approved eighteen hundred great hall inspection of the builder's lighting and tables.

The unusual business is the quiet preparation in the great hall. At 07:38 I heard Freight say both entrances were closed and ask for an open shutter at (-46, -59, 31) to be closed too. Freight said they would keep everything quiet until eighteen. Yesterday I also saw a block at (-58, -60, 26) change from air to oak planks. These may relate to the hall preparations, but I have not verified that connection or seen what is being prepared. The timing suggests preparations for the eighteen hundred inspection, perhaps something intended to remain unseen until then; that is only my inference, not something anyone has confirmed.

The secretary has confirmed that the inspection is entered in my updated appointment book. An earlier schedule copy omitted it, but this morning I read the updated entry myself. The secretary reports not yet finding the builder at the workshop and intends to notify them when found. She also says she does not know why Freight requested the closures and will ask directly. She has promised not to change access to my office without my approval. I have not yet received her findings. My neighbour is now nearby, but has not told me any new business. I do not yet know of any emergency or wrongdoing.
